column1: # expected.tsv --- the oracle. Fixtures + verdicts are the reusable asset, not pmnotes.sh.
# Every verdict the checker can reach appears exactly once, so a change that quietly stops
# checking a field shows up as one row flipping to OK rather than as a silent pass. The row that
# earns its keep is UNNAMED-SOURCE: it caught a real parsing bug on first run, where the From:
# capture ran past the em-dash separator into Would-change: and the case read as OK.

column2: Throughput is about 40 requests a second (triggers: "throughput", "capacity")
The build takes about nine minutes
